name: Backward Jump
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and confirm the floor behind you is completely clear.
Hinge your hips back slightly, bend your knees, and swing your arms down to load the jump.
Drive forcefully off both feet while swinging your arms back to leap smoothly backward.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees and hips to absorb the impact cleanly before resetting.
tips: Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes on every landing.
Start with modest jump distances until your backward landing balance feels completely controlled.
